answer: Identity Drag Escrow: each new agent identity posts collateral that unlocks only as it routes real work through an established operator's downstream river of settled transactions. Every duplicate pays the full collateral again plus a per-identity drag fee that decays with genuine volume, so the cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count. At each dawn the escrow reconciles against delivery receipts, and fake identities forfeit collateral to the operators they burdened. A single inlet of fresh identities therefore drains the attacker's capital without touching honest wallets.
